Piece dish from an IFCT cooked entry: weigh the cooked pieces and put their number in pieces_per_batch; cooked_g_per_piece = their cooked grams ÷ pieces_per_batch. Leave the raw gram fields empty. M004 is IFCT's value for a boiled egg: weigh the eggs boiled and peeled.

Piece dish from an IFCT cooked entry: weigh the cooked pieces and put their number in pieces_per_batch; cooked_g_per_piece = their cooked grams ÷ pieces_per_batch. Leave the raw gram fields empty. M007 is IFCT's value for an omelette: weigh the cooked omelettes. Whether M007 includes cooking oil is unclear: the IFCT 2017 book does not say how it was prepared (food-list-sources.md), so it is not known whether oil should be added here.

Katori dish: weigh the raw batch and put the number of 200 ml katoris it fills in katoris_per_batch; each gram field = that ingredient's raw grams in the batch ÷ katoris_per_batch. Choose the chicken: N002 Chicken, poultry, thigh, skinless, or N003 Chicken, poultry, breast, skinless. N001 (leg) is hidden until it is checked against the IFCT book. Whether IFCT's poultry values are raw is unclear: the book's page xx excepts poultry and egg from raw food, its preface (page i) only eggs (food-list-sources.md).
